title: The Defenders
sourcePageTitle: The Defenders Reading Order - Comic Book Herald

occurrences.sourceText: Depending on when and where you entered the Marvel Comics universe, there are essentially two very distinct Defenders units to consider. The first is the epic “non-team,” beginning with Namor, Doctor Strange, Silver Surfer, and Hulk, an Avengers-like collection of heroes who refuse to formalize the thing and hold roll call like a bunch of cubscouts.
occurrences.sourceRangeReference: Depending on when and where you entered the Marvel Comics universe, there are essentially two very distinct Defenders units to consider. The first is the epic “non-team,” beginning with Namor, Doctor Strange, Silver Surfer, and Hulk, an Avengers-like collection of heroes who refuse to formalize the thing and hold roll call like a bunch of cubscouts.

occurrences.sourceText: The second unit of Defenders is straight from the gritty binge watch of Marvel Netflix, featuring Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, and Iron Fist.
occurrences.sourceRangeReference: The second unit of Defenders is straight from the gritty binge watch of Marvel Netflix, featuring Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, and Iron Fist.

occurrences.sourceText: Prior to the Netflix reincarnation, the Defenders were Marvel’s oddball squad, not quite as immaterial as The Champions, but sporting an ever-rotating lineup and glorious willingness to just get weird.
occurrences.sourceRangeReference: Prior to the Netflix reincarnation, the Defenders were Marvel’s oddball squad, not quite as immaterial as The Champions, but sporting an ever-rotating lineup and glorious willingness to just get weird.

occurrences.sourceText: Doctor Strange may well be the team’s most consistent member, but depending on the era, fans may nominate Valkyrie, Nighthawk, or the elf with a gun as their favorite recurring character (just kidding; no one would nominate Nighthawk).
